-- Additional authoritative state for the legacy Web. No existing rows are overwritten.
CREATE TABLE web_background_jobs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES task_executions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  family_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES families(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  baby_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  input JSONB NOT NULL,
  claimed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT web_background_jobs_baby_fk FOREIGN KEY(family_id,baby_id) REFERENCES babies(family_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT web_background_jobs_request_uq UNIQUE(user_id,kind,client_request_id)
);
CREATE INDEX web_background_jobs_user_created ON web_background_jobs(user_id,created_at DESC,id DESC);
CREATE TABLE web_job_retries (
  job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES web_background_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(job_id,command_id)
);
CREATE TABLE web_voice_logs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  family_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES families(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  baby_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
  reply TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_async BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  is_fast_path BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  acknowledged BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT web_voice_logs_baby_fk FOREIGN KEY(family_id,baby_id) REFERENCES babies(family_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX web_voice_logs_user_created ON web_voice_logs(user_id,created_at DESC,id DESC);
CREATE TABLE web_history_imports (
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  payload JSONB NOT NULL,
  imported_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(user_id,kind,source_id)
);

CREATE TABLE "web_chat_retries" (
  "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "ai_runs"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "command_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("run_id", "command_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "web_session_commands" (
  "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "users"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "command_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "request_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "command_id")
);
